dialogues.speaker: Gracie
dialogues.text: Whether you wish to go to the opera house or the Fountain of Lucine, please head southward along this large road.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about the opera house...

dialogues.speaker: Gracie
dialogues.text: The most magnificent building on Erinnyes is the Opera Epiclese. When we Fontainians speak of the "opera house," that's what we're normally referring to.

dialogues.speaker: Gracie
dialogues.text: It has another, more important role, besides serving as a site for various cultural performances.

dialogues.speaker: Gracie
dialogues.text: It is also a courtroom in which all cases in Fontaine are judged.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about the Fountain of Lucine...

dialogues.speaker: Gracie
dialogues.text: That is where all the waters in our land gather, and so it is the most popular site for wishes.

dialogues.speaker: Gracie
dialogues.text: Couples who wish for children go there, believing that the spirits in the water will bless them with healthy and happy children.
